primary_chain_dispositions.rationale: The failure is loss of safely observable history distinctions that change feasible normal-tangential impedance or its outcome, not lack of a physically complete environment model.
The selected and rendered action must be produced by one total relation that accounts for performance, hard limits and computation availability; no particular totality mechanism is assumed.

required_mechanism_changes.required_mechanism_change: Replace them with the smallest safely observable history representation whose action-conditional capacity set preserves robust impedance feasibility, ranking and outcome, with declared-population calibration and support-aware abstention.

required_mechanism_changes.root_cause_resolution_rationale: It retains contact area, geometry, tangential wrench or memory only when they change the downstream decision, avoiding both a memoryless scalar model and an unnecessary digital twin.

required_mechanism_changes.failed_relation_state_or_information_str: Performance-oriented gains are proposed separately from uncertain contact capacity, wrench, energy, actuator/gain-rate, infeasibility, fallback and deadline checks, so the intended and applied actions diverge or no action exists at the deadline.
required_mechanism_changes.required_mechanism_change: Make the applied impedance or declared fallback the output of one total update-time relation in which joint performance, all hard limits and computation/fallback availability determine the action, with at least one admissible output at every declared deadline.
required_mechanism_changes.change_direction: FROM performance-first proposal followed by correction or timeout handling TO one total feasible applied-action relation
required_mechanism_changes.activation_condition: Physical, uncertainty or computation margins become active
required_mechanism_changes.root_cause_resolution_rationale: This repairs selection-feasibility decoupling without prematurely requiring incumbent retention, a barrier certificate or any other candidate-specific realization.

required_capabilities.required_capability: Retain safely observable contact information only when it changes robust impedance feasibility, ranking or held-out joint outcome.
acceptance_conditions: Each retained information family adds reproducible held-out decision value under matched model and compute resources.

required_capabilities.required_capability: Return action-conditional one-sided sets for wrench, slip, contact-loss, energy and actuator margins with an explicit support rule.
acceptance_conditions: The exact optimizer-consumed margins meet a declared held-out coverage target; unsupported contexts abstain to a conservative admissible set.

required_capabilities.required_capability: Choose time-varying normal-tangential stiffness and damping only from actions jointly feasible for capacity, wrench, energy, actuator and gain-rate limits.
acceptance_conditions: The executed gains are an output of the same relation evaluated for performance and all hard limits; no downstream guard silently changes them.

required_capabilities.required_capability: Produce an admissible impedance or declared fallback at every update deadline despite timeout, abstention or optimization infeasibility.
acceptance_conditions: Every terminal compute outcome has a logged admissible applied action and bounded response latency.

design_obligations.design_obligation: Define action equivalence over the declared impedance decision class and discard information that improves reconstruction but not robust decisions or outcomes.
acceptance_conditions: A nested-information ablation identifies a smallest state within a declared decision-regret tolerance.

design_obligations.design_obligation: Calibrate the action-conditional future-margin vector actually consumed by the controller on a declared shift population, and separate miscoverage from unsupported contexts.
acceptance_conditions: Calibration, support detection and controller tuning use disjoint evidence; arbitrary-shift coverage is not claimed.

design_obligations.design_obligation: Apply contact, wrench, interaction-energy, actuator and gain-rate limits to the same impedance variables that optimize force, tracking, contact-loss and slip performance.
acceptance_conditions: Penalized quantities are not called hard limits; any backup action belongs to the same admissible-action definition.

design_obligations.design_obligation: Define one total mapping from update context and compute outcome to an admissible applied action, including infeasibility, timeout and abstention.
acceptance_conditions: Forced interruption changes achieved cost, not existence or declared feasibility of the applied action.

premises: Contact information matters only through feasible-action or outcome differences.
Hard constraints require one-sided future margins, not only mean predictions.

boundaries: The representation is not a material-identification claim.

premises: A physical controller needs one action at every update.
A hard limit is meaningful only for the action actually rendered.
derivation_steps: Define the admissible impedance set from the calibrated capacity, energy, actuator and gain-rate state.
Optimize joint performance only over that set.
Extend the relation to every timeout, infeasibility and abstention outcome with an admissible action.
first_principles.derived_intervention: One total relation from update context and computation state to the applied feasible impedance.
first_principles.rmc_resolution_rationale: It makes selected and applied actions identical without selecting a particular totality mechanism.

boundaries: Incumbent retention and viability certification remain rival realizations.

premises: A verified admissible action exists at update start.
Only fully verified improvements may replace it.

Return the incumbent at the deadline.
first_principles.derived_intervention: Anytime robust horizon optimization with feasible-incumbent persistence.
first_principles.rmc_resolution_rationale: Optimization convergence affects cost but not action existence.

boundaries: BOX-FDDP itself does not prove this persistence property.

premises: A controlled-invariant admissible set can encode the augmented contact, energy and gain state.
A certified backup action is evaluable within the deadline.
derivation_steps: Define a capacity-conditioned viability certificate over augmented state.
Restrict optimization to certificate-preserving impedance actions.
Include the certificate backup action in the same admissible decision relation.
Return the optimized member or certified backup by deadline.
first_principles.derived_intervention: Certificate-carrying admissible-impedance relation with an internal backup action.
first_principles.rmc_resolution_rationale: Totality follows from the viable action set rather than solver-incumbent persistence.

boundaries: A post-hoc supervisor is not sufficient; performance and backup must share the admissible relation.

Both candidates integrate all four obligations and differ causally, not merely by solver choice.
